text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, when did your fever start relative to delivery, and have you noticed any foul-smelling vaginal discharge or changes in your uterine tenderness?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible urinary retention or bowel obstruction.
